Gathering occurs at predetermined spots during the day section, marked by glittering particles. The player may interact with gathering spots, spending 30 minutes to gather resources from the location.

Every gathering spot has the following information:

* The timeframe in which it appears.
* The "refresh time", defining how long it takes for the gathering spot to refill.
* Its primary resource, which the player will always acquire.
* A list of secondary resources, which are each rolled to check if the player will receive them.

All gathering spots give resources according to the following algorithm:

# The player will, no matter what, gain the primary resource for the gathering spot, in the amount defined.
# Afterward, the game rolls to see if the player gets the secondary resources as well. Each secondary has its defined percentage chance of dropping.
# The game then rolls the player's Extra Resource Gathering Probability independently for each resource, doubling the amount gained if the roll succeeded.
# If the player has a [[Items|Lucky Clover]], gained from [[Inaba Tewi|Tewi]]'s reward card, an additional 1-2 is added to each resource gained. This only applies to secondaries if the player rolled to receive them. Gathering spots that give the same ingredient from multiple sources will add the bonus only once, after summing up the default gained.
